knowledge.plain_language_summary: Internally lit dimensional brand letters: 1.5in-thick translucent white acrylic letterforms with a CNC-milled interior void for LEDs and a removable, tapped acrylic back, stud-mounted off the wall on a dedicated circuit.
knowledge.rationale: Built-up acrylic with an internal void gives a soft glowing feature letter; the removable tapped back makes the LEDs serviceable.

structure.construction: laser-cut 1.5in 2447 translucent white acrylic, CNC-milled interior void, 12V 3000K warm-white LEDs, 3/16in removable acrylic back drilled/tapped for studs
10-24 aluminum all-thread studs set in silicone-filled wall holes; Class II 12V supply, J-box w/ disconnect, dedicated 120V/20A circuit

compliance.notes: Electrical only (Class II LV, disconnect, dedicated circuit); no ADA tactile (branding).

craft_observations: Removable tapped acrylic back = serviceable LEDs, a notable maintainability detail.
